text:
Predicates:
AppropriateForAllAges(x) ::: x is appropriate for people of all ages.
ChildrenCanWatchWithoutGuidance(x) ::: children can watch x without guidance from parents.
ContainsExcessiveContent(x) ::: x contains excessive erotic and violent content.
RatedGeneralAudience(x) ::: x is rated General Audience.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) ::: x is a family-friendly animated film.
InSeries(x, y) ::: x is in series y.
Film(x) ::: x is a film.
Premises:
∀x (AppropriateForAllAges(x) → ChildrenCanWatchWithoutGuidance(x)) ::: If a film is appropriate for all ages, children can watch it without guidance.
∀x (ContainsExcessiveContent(x) → ¬ChildrenCanWatchWithoutGuidance(x)) ::: If a film contains excessive content, children cannot watch it without guidance.
∀x (RatedGeneralAudience(x) → AppropriateForAllAges(x)) ::: If a film is rated General Audience, it is appropriate for all ages.
∀x (FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) → RatedGeneralAudience(x)) ::: All family-friendly animated films are rated General Audience.
∀x (InSeries(x, frozenSeries) → FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x)) ::: All movies in the Frozen series are family-friendly animated films.
Film(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is a film.
AppropriateOrExcessiveContent(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is either a family-friendly animated film or is appropriate for all ages.
Conclusion:
(ContainsExcessiveContent(hachi) ∧ InSeries(hachi, frozenSeries)) ∨ (¬ContainsExcessiveContent(hachi) ∧ ¬InSeries(hachi, frozenSeries)) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' either contains excessive content and is in the Frozen series, or it neither contains excessive content nor is in the Frozen series.
